summary: Kaggle kernel rikirinjani/notebook7d73bc48b5 ended in ERROR: no input zip found under /kaggle/input/ (dataset not attached to notebook).
root_cause: User uploaded dataset rikirinjani/klaim2026 (2.1GB, klaim.zip) but did not attach it to the notebook via '+ Add Input' — Kaggle notebooks can only see attached datasets under /kaggle/input/. Notebook's input-glob found nothing and raised SystemExit before any extraction ran.
